paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Saul kiang a thu agen khit in Jonathan hinna leh David hinna ahong kipeh geih a, huchi in Jonathan in ama hinna a-it bang in amah a-it hi.
english: When he had finished speaking to Saul, the soul of Jonathan was knit with the soul of David, and Jonathan loved him as his own soul.

paite: Saul in huai ni in a-omsak ngal a, apa inn ah apaisak nawnta kei hi.
english: Saul took him that day, and wouldn’t let him go home to his father’s house any more.

paite: Huchi in ama hinna bang geih a amah a-it ziak in Jonathan in David toh thu akhung hi.
english: Then Jonathan and David made a covenant, because he loved him as his own soul.

paite: Jonathan in apuansilh lai asuah a, David apia a, akivatna leh anamsau leh athalpeu leh ataigakna nangawn apia hi.
english: Jonathan stripped himself of the robe that was on him and gave it to David with his clothing, even including his sword, his bow, and his sash.

paite: Saul in asawlna peuh ah David ahoh zel a, kizentak in agamtang hi. Saul in sepaihte heutu in amah abawl a, hiai tuh mi tengteng ngaih in leh Saul sikhate ngaih in ahoih hi.
english: David went out wherever Saul sent him, and behaved himself wisely; and Saul set him over the men of war. It was good in the sight of all the people, and also in the sight of Saul’s servants.

paite: Ahong pai un hichi ahong hi a, Philistia mi that David ahong pai in Israel kho teng ah numeite lasa leh lam kawm in khuangta leh thil gingtheite toh, nuamsatak in kumpipa Saul dawn ding in ahong pawtkhia uhi.
heading: Saul In David Ahaza
english: As they came, when David returned from the slaughter of the Philistine, the women came out of all the cities of Israel, singing and dancing, to meet King Saul with tambourines, with joy, and with instruments of music.

paite: Numeite'n lam kawm ala a kidawngtuah in, "Saul in asang asang athat, David in asing asing," achi uhi.
english: The women sang to one another as they played, and said, “Saul has slain his thousands, and David his ten thousands.”

paite: Hiai lasak in Saul akipaksak kei a, aheh mahmah hi. David bel asing asing that in angai ua, kei ka hihleh asang asang kia that in ahon ngai uh. Kumpigam lou ngal atan ding dang bang ahia om? achi hi.
english: Saul was very angry, and this saying displeased him. He said, “They have credited David with ten thousands, and they have only credited me with thousands. What can he have more but the kingdom?”

paite: Saul in huai ni a pan David ahazat bawlta hi.
english: Saul watched David from that day and forward.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, azingsang in Saul tung ah Pathian sawl kha gilou ahong tung a, insung ah thu agen hi. David in nidang a ahih mah bang in kaihging atum hi. Saul in ateipi atawi hi.
english: On the next day, an evil spirit from God came mightily on Saul, and he prophesied in the middle of the house. David played with his hand, as he did day by day. Saul had his spear in his hand;

paite: Saul in ateipi akhoh a, "Huai baang ah David ka khohden ding," achi hi. David in nihvei akihepkhiaksan hi.
english: and Saul threw the spear, for he said, “I will pin David to the wall!” David escaped from his presence twice.

paite: Akiang a ToUPA a-om ziak leh Saul apaisan ziak in Saul in David alau hi.
english: Saul was afraid of David, because Yahweh was with him, and had departed from Saul.

paite: Huaiziak in Saul in amah a pan akisuansak a, asepaih sangkhat tung a heutu in abawl hi. Huchi in mipi lak ah David lut in apawt zel hi.
english: Therefore Saul removed him from his presence, and made him his captain over a thousand; and he went out and came in before the people.

paite: David bel ahih peuhmah ah piltak in agamtang zel a; akiang ah TOUPA a-om hi.
english: David behaved himself wisely in all his ways; and Yahweh was with him.

paite: Saul in piltak in agamtang chih amuh in alau hi.
english: When Saul saw that he behaved himself very wisely, he stood in awe of him.

paite: Himahleh Israelte leh Judahte tengteng in David a-it uh; alak ua lut a pawt zel lah ahi ngal a.
english: But all Israel and Judah loved David; for he went out and came in before them.

paite: Saul in David kiang ah, "Ngai in, ka tanu upazaw Merab na zi ding in ka hon neisak ding. Hangtak in hon gum peuhmah lechin. TOUPA kidounate dou in," achi hi. Saul in, "Ke'n zaw atung a khut kha lou in Philistia mite'n atung ah khut kha zaw uhen," achi hi.
heading: David In Saul Tanu Akitenpih
english: Saul said to David, “Behold, my elder daughter Merab. I will give her to you as wife. Only be valiant for me, and fight Yahweh’s battles.” For Saul said, “Don’t let my hand be on him, but let the hand of the Philistines be on him.”

paite: David in Saul kiang ah, "Kua ahia ka hih a, ka hinna leh Israelte lak a ka pa inkuante leng bang ahia ahih uh, kumpipa makpa ka hihna ding?" achi hi,
english: David said to Saul, “Who am I, and what is my life, or my father’s family in Israel, that I should be son-in-law to the king?”

paite: Himahleh hichi ahong hi a, David toh Saul tanu Merab kitensak ahong hun in, Meholath mi Adriel zi ding in ape mawk hi.
english: But at the time when Merab, Saul’s daughter, should have been given to David, she was given to Adriel the Meholathite as wife.

paite: Saul tanu Mikal in David a-it a; Saul ahilh ua; huai in akipaksak hi.
english: Michal, Saul’s daughter, loved David; and they told Saul, and the thing pleased him.

paite: Saul in, "A-awkna ding thang ahong hihtheihna ding leh Philistia mite'n atung a khut akhaktheihna ding un amah ka pe ding," achi hi. Huaiziak in Saul in David kiang ah, "Tuni in ka makpa na hihna ding hunlem anihveina na nei," achi hi.
english: Saul said, I will give her to him, that she may be a snare to him and that the hand of the Philistines may be against him. Therefore Saul said to David a second time, “You shall today be my son-in-law.”

paite: Huchi in Saul in asikhate thu apia a, "Asimtham in David houpih unla, ngai in, kumpipa na tung ah akipak mahmah a, asikhate tengteng in leng nang ahon it uh. Huchi in kumpipa makpa in om in, chi un," achi hi.
english: Saul commanded his servants, “Talk with David secretly, and say, ‘Behold, the king has delight in you, and all his servants love you. Now therefore be the king’s son-in-law.’”

paite: Saul sikhate'n huai thu David bil ah agen uhi. David in, "Mizawng leh kuamah theih phak ngel louh kei a ding in kumpipa makpa hih thil namai in na sep ua hia?" achi hi.
english: Saul’s servants spoke those words in the ears of David. David said, “Does it seem to you a light thing to be the king’s son-in-law, since I am a poor man and little known?”

paite: Saul sikhate'n, "David in huchibang in achi," chi in ahilh uh.
english: The servants of Saul told him, saying, “David spoke like this.”

paite: Saul in David kiang ah hichibang in na chi ding uh, "Kumpipa'n kumpipa melma phulakna ding in Philistia mite zekvun zakhat chih louh man bangmah adeih kei achi, chi un," achi hi. Saul in David lah Philistia mite khut a sihsak lungsim in anei bikbek hi.
english: Saul said, “Tell David, ‘The king desires no dowry except one hundred foreskins of the Philistines, to be avenged of the king’s enemies.’” Now Saul thought he would make David fall by the hand of the Philistines.

paite: Asikhate'n huai thu David ahilh uleh kumpipa makpa hih David akipak mahmah hi.
english: When his servants told David these words, it pleased David well to be the king’s son-in-law. Before the deadline,

paite: Huchi in ni chiamte abei ma in, David leh amite athou ua, Philistia mite zanih ava that uhi. David in azekvun uh ahon pua a, kumpipa makpa ahihtheihna ding in kumpipa kimtak in apia hi. Huchi in Saul in atanu Mikal azi ding in apeta hi.
english: David arose and went, he and his men, and killed two hundred men of the Philistines. Then David brought their foreskins, and they gave them in full number to the king, that he might be the king’s son-in-law. Then Saul gave him Michal his daughter as wife.

paite: Saul in David kiang ah Pathian a-om chih atheitelta hi. Saul tanu Mikal in amah a-it hi.
english: Saul saw and knew that Yahweh was with David; and Michal, Saul’s daughter, loved him.

paite: Huchi in Saul in David alau semsem a, Saul bel David melma ahi denta hi.
english: Saul was even more afraid of David; and Saul was David’s enemy continually.

paite: Philistia' miliante ava kuankhe zel uhi. Huan hichi ahong hi a, akuankhiak peuhmah chiang ua Saul sikha tengteng sang a piltak a David agamtat ziak in amin athang semsem hi.
english: Then the princes of the Philistines went out; and as often as they went out, David behaved himself more wisely than all the servants of Saul, so that his name was highly esteemed.
